name: RecurrencePatternEditor
tagline: The Recurrence Pattern Editor turns a plain text column into an Outlook-style repeat schedule.
description: The Recurrence Pattern Editor turns a plain text column into an Outlook-style repeat schedule. Instead of typing rules, people pick how often something repeats, on which days, when it starts and when it ends. The control writes a clear sentence such as "Every 2 weeks on Monday and Wednesday at 09:00, starting Mon 2 Nov 2026, 10 times" and shows the upcoming dates in a list or calendar.
features: Monthly (day, nth weekday or nth working day) and yearly patterns with start
Holiday handling (flag, skip or move), skip-this-date actions
A list and calendar preview of upcoming dates and a plain-English summary
Saves a standard iCalendar RRULE or JSON
